entries.content: (d-0) (The title of this book, 'Isaiah'), Meaning, 'Salvation of Jah.' see Ps. 68.4.
rebelled (a-23) Often 'transgressed,' as ch. 66.24. but has the force of 'rebellion.' It is transgression against authority to which one is rightfully subject. See 1Kings 12.19.
Ah (b-1) Or 'Woe to the.' nation, (c-3) Goi. the nations in contrast with God's people, used of Israel when disowned, as Ps. 43.1. away (d-32) Lit. 'are estranged.'
gladden (f-7) Others, 'set right,' or 'guide.' to (g-12) Or, as ver. 23, 'judge.'
saith (a-2) A word introducing an oracular discourse, as Gen. 22.16. It is frequent in the Prophets. hosts, (b-7) See Jas. 5.4. me (c-17) As 'comforts himself,' Gen. 27.42.
thoroughly (d-11) Lit. according to pureness;' the root of the word is 'purity.' alloy; (e-21) Or 'lead,' anything mixed with the silver ore.
with (f-5) Or 'delivered through.' her (g-12) Or 'her penitents.'

(h-0) For vers. 2-4 see Mic. 4.1-3. days, (i-11) See Heb. 1.2. A Hebrew expression implying the end of the period of law, when Messiah was to be introduced. It introduces the days of Messiah. It occurs Gen. 49.1; Num. 24.14; Deut. 4.30; 31.29; Jer. 23.20; 30.24; 48.47; 49.39; Ezek. 38.16; Dan. 2.28; 10.14; Hos. 3.5; Mic. 4.1.
man (n-4) Adam; an ordinary man, one of the people. man (a-12) Ish. as chs. 5.15; 31.8. In these passages 'mean man' is Adam. Compare Ps. 49.2; 62.9.
enchantments. (f-22) Lit. 'whisperings.' the charmer, as Jer. 8.17.
children (g-10) Some take the word as 'childish things,' or 'caprices.'
crescents, (c-18) Or 'the networks, and the little moons.'
hill. (a-23) Lit. 'horn of a son of fatness.'
cultivated, (b-15) Or 'hoed.' the word apparently means 'to gather the earth about the roots, while removing weeds.' see ch. 7.25.

cry. (c-36) There is an assonance in each set of words, which may be represented in both cases by the similarity of 'right' and 'might.' What is called paronomasia abounds in this book. See ch. 7.9; Gen. 49.8,16,19; Judg. 15.16; Mic. 1.10 to 15.
ephah. (d-18) The tenth part of a homer. A homer was ten ephahs and an ephah was ten omers. see Ezek. 45.11; Ex. 16.36.
lyre, (e-4) Or 'lute.' work (f-19) Poal, as chs. 1.31; 45.9, 'a thing done.'
high (e-18) The Hebrew might mean, the Lord was high.
me. (a-27) The emphasis is rather on 'send' than on 'me.'
see (b-24) Or 'Hearing, hear ... and seeing, see ...' perceive. (c-28) Or 'know.' see ch. 41.20; 2Kings 4.9.
land (e-24) Adamah, 'soil.' as Deut. 26.2; in ver. 12 it is erets, 'the earth.' see 1Sam. 2.8.
eaten; (g-15) Or 'and it shall be eaten up again.'
established. (l-25) In the Hebrew for 'believe' and 'be established,' there is an assonance greater than in confide and abide.
above. (m-20) Lit. 'make deep the request, or soar upward.'
the (a-11) * Emphatic article. Immanuel. (b-25) Meaning, 'God (El) with us.' Matt. 1.23
Butter (c-1) Or 'cream,' or 'curds.' know (d-10) Or 'until he know.'
fearest (e-21) The word implies 'fear' and 'aversion,' as Ex. 1.12; Num. 21.5, 'loathe.'
Maher-shalal-hash-baz. (g-19) Meaning, 'Swift for spoil, hasty for prey.'
took (h-3) Others have 'let me take,' or 'I will take.'
plan, (b-3) Lit. 'Counsel a counsel.' us. (c-22) Heb. Immanuel. see ver. 8, and ch. 7.14.
them (g-16) Or 'for him,' i.e. for the people. Some read 'this word, it is because in it.'
Wonderful, (a-27) See Judg. 13.18. Eternity, (b-33) Or 'Father of the age.'
hypocrite (e-28) Or 'profane,' 'impious.' see ch. 33.14. folly. (f-36) Or 'villainy.' Nabal. see ch. 32.5; Prov. 17.7.
crouch (g-4) Or 'Without me, they shall crouch.'
Calno (b-3) i.e. Calneh. see Gen. 10.10; Amos 6.2.
wood! (c-44) Or 'the staff lift up [itself] as if it were not wood.'
return, (e-4) Heb. Shearjashub, the name of the prophet's elder son see ch. 7.3.
determined (f-22) A technical expression for the judgments preceding Messiah's reign. see ch. 28.22; Dan. 9.27, &c.
... (a-38) Lit. 'oil;' some, continuing the metaphor, translate 'fatness.'
boughs (c-10) Great or high branches, making the beauty of a tree. violence; (d-12) Lit. 'terror.'
delight (e-3) Lit. 'his scent.' reprove (f-23) Or 'set right,' or 'maintain the right for.' see ch. 2.4, and Prov. 9.8.
reprove (f-10) Or 'set right,' or 'maintain the right for.' see ch. 2.4, and Prov. 9.8. meek (g-14) Or 'afflicted.' earth. (h-17) earth (h-23) Or 'the land.'
Jesse, (i-11) * Meaning, 'Jah exists.' it; (k-23) i.e. the root.
Pathros, (a-39) Upper Egypt. Cush, (b-42) Ethiopia. Elam, (c-45) Persia.
Jah, (d-14) See Ex. 15.2; Ps. 68.4; 118.14. salvation. (e-26) Or 'my deliverance.'
of (f-3) See Ps. 47.6. known (g-13) Or 'Let this be known.'
Almighty. (k-16) There is an assonance in 'destruction' and 'Almighty.' Shod, Shaddai; the same in Joel 1.15.
man (l-11) Here Enosh. as Gen. 4.26; Job 4.17.
flames. (a-34) Lit. 'their faces, faces of flames.'
man (b-5) Enosh. as ver. 7. man (c-12) Adam, as Gen. 1.26.
possess (g-19) See Lev. 25.46, 'leave them as an inheritance.'
dead (a-17) Or 'shades,' ch. 26.19. (last occurrence of word 'dead'); Ps. 88.10 ('shades'). he-goats (b-22) As Ezek. 34.17; Zech. 10.3.
descendant, (d-23) Or 'son and grandson;' the Hebrew is the same as in Gen. 21.23. see also Job 18.19.
bittern, (e-10) According to others, 'the hedgehog.' so ch. 34.11; Zeph. 2.14.
Bajith, (b-6) Some take Bajith as an appellative, reading 'to the house,' i.e. the house of his god.
Eglath-Sheli-shijah. (d-14) Meaning, 'a heifer of three years old.'
of (e-4) Or 'to.' wilderness, (f-15) Or 'from Sela in the wilderness.'
oppressors (h-32) Lit. 'trampler' (in the singular). land. (i-38) Or 'out of the earth.'
woodland, (e-15) Or 'as a bare place in a thick wood.'
grow, (a-12) Or 'wilt thou hedge them round.' morrow (b-16) Or 'in the morning.' incurable. (c-40) Or 'the harvest will be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.'
Ha! (d-1) Or 'Woe to.' nations! (e-22) Leummim, races of mankind. see Ps. 2.1.
nations (e-2) Leummim, races of mankind. see Ps. 2.1. he (f-11) i.e. God.
ravaged, (g-24) Or 'peeled,' 'plucked.' terrible (h-28) Or 'marvellous.' waiting (i-39) Or 'of measure, measure,' i.e. measured by the judgments of God.
herbs, (k-24) Or 'like clear heat by sunshine.'
terrible (h-24) Or 'marvellous.' waiting (i-34) Or 'of measure, measure,' i.e. measured by the judgments of God.
sea, (b-8) The word is applied also to a large river; here the Nile.
streams (c-8) Or 'canals.' Egypt (d-10) The Hebrew is Matsor, applied originally to the fortified part of Egypt in the north-east, 2Kings 19.24.
Zoan (f-4) Tanis. see ch. 30.4. Noph (g-11) Memphis.
Heres. (h-32) Meaning, 'City of destruction,' or, according to others, 'City of the sun,' perhaps Heliopolis.
Tartan (a-5) The title of the general-in-chief of the king of Assyria. see 2Kings 18.17.
sea. (c-8) i.e. Babylon. south (d-13) Negeb. see Gen. 12.9.
Elam! (e-18) i.e. Persia, as ch. 11.11. Media! (f-20) As ch. 13.17. thereof (g-24) Babylon's, or that which Babylon caused.
see. (h-38) Or 'I am bowed down at the report, dismayed at the sight.'
chariots, (k-4) Or 'a cavalcade.' with (l-10) with (l-14) Or 'cavalry on.'
fleeth. (b-23) Or 'come to meet him that fleeth, with bread for him.'
bow. (c-13) Possibly meaning, 'made prisoners by the archers.'
shame (a-30) Or 'they shall be the shame.'
isle! (e-7) Or 'of the [sea] coast,' as ver. 6.
Tyre. (f-16) Or 'As at the report concerning Egypt, they are sorely pained at the report of Tyre.'
land (c-5) Erets, 'earth.' see 1Sam. 2.8. The prophecy begins with the land of Israel, and the scene enlarges, embracing (ver. 4) the whole world, of which the 'land' is the centre.
guilty; (d-15) Or 'are made desolate.' see Ps. 34.21,22.
These (a-1) Those spared in the dispersion of Israel.
east, (b-6) Or 'in the lands of light.' west. (c-20) Or 'the sea.'
earth (d-6) Or 'end (lit. 'wing') of the land.' righteous! (e-14) Or 'the Righteous One.' singular.
snare (f-7) See Jer. 48.43; 'fear,' 'pit,' 'snare,' in Hebrew make a play on words.
glory. (g-28) Or 'and there shall be glory before his ancients.'
destroy (k-4) Lit. 'swallow up,' as ver. 8; ch. 3.12.
victory. (l-7) Or 'for ever,' as Job 4.20. Ps. 9.6.
even. (e-18) Or 'dost weigh the path (see Prov. 2.9) of the just.'
memorial. (f-27) Or 'to the remembrance of thee;' but cf. Ex. 3.15; Ps. 102.12, &c.
people, (g-20) Or 'they shall see, and be ashamed for [their] jealousy of the people.'
earth. (h-26) Or 'Thou hast extended all the boundaries of the land.'
bodies (a-7) According to others '[with] my dead body, they.' morning, (b-28) Lit. 'the lights.' earth (c-31) Or 'land.' dead. (d-36) As ch. 14.9.
leviathan (e-15) leviathan (e-20) As Job 3.8. fleeing (f-17) Or 'straight.' sea. (g-34) See Note, ch. 19.5.
wine; (h-11) Or 'a pleasant vineyard.' see Amos 5.11. sing (i-12) 'Sing in turn,' or 'alternately.' see Ex. 32.18.
overpowered (c-28) Lit. 'are swallowed up,' as ch. 3.12.
foundation. (d-24) Lit. 'a foundation well-founded.' haste. (e-31) i.e. shall not hasten with fear.
closed (a-15) Lit. 'to shut strongly.' so ch. 33.15.
work (f-8) Or 'when his children shall see the work.' fear (g-31) 'Fear' with 'dread.' see ch. 8.12,13; Ps. 89.7.
protection (k-21) Or 'to strengthen themselves with the strength.'
his (l-2) i.e. Judah's. Hanes. (a-12) Tahpanhes. see Jer. 2.16; 43.7; Ezek. 30.18. Heracleopolis, in Central Egypt.
Arrogance, (b-16) Heb. Rahab, a name of Egypt.
record (c-11) Lit. 'engrave.' witness (d-27) Instead of 'as a witness for ever,' many take it as 'for ever and ever;' but cf. Deut. 31.26.
prophets, (e-11) Lit. 'those who have visions,' as Num. 24.4.
mercy (g-24) Or 'will he withdraw himself until he have mercy.'
of (h-9) of (h-14) Or 'in.' hidden (i-22) Or 'turn themselves away.'
you. (b-26) Or, 'which your own hands have made unto you to sin.'
rock, (d-10) Or 'his rock shall pass away.' fire (e-23) Lit. 'light.'
man (f-3) Nabal. see Note o, Prov. 1.7. 'villainy,' in ver. 6, and 'folly,' ch. 9.17, are from same root. churl (g-12) Or 'miser,' so ver. 7.
man (f-4) Nabal. see Note o, Prov. 1.7. 'villainy,' in ver. 6, and 'folly,' ch. 9.17, are from same root. hypocrisy, (h-16) Or 'impiety,' as ch. 9.17.
days (k-6) Or 'For days beyond a year.'
hill (l-15) Or, as a proper name, 'Ophel.'
caterpillar. (b-12) Lit. 'the devourer.' see Ps. 78.46; Joel 1.4.
knowledge. (c-16) Or 'wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, the riches of salvation.' your (d-23) Lit. 'his,' i.e. Israel's.
Sharon (e-12) See Note, 1Chron. 27.29 desert, (f-17) The Arabah. see Note b, Josh. 3.16.
of (a-11) or 'the mighty Jehovah will there be for us a place of.'
emptiness. (e-36) 'Waste ... emptiness.' see ch. 45.18; Gen. 1.2; Jer. 4.23.
it (a-15) i.e. the land of Edom.
reeds (d-29) Or '[shall be] a court for reeds.' rushes. (e-31) Or 'papyrus.'
Rab-shakeh (f-7) Title of the chief cup-bearer.
Same, (b-15) A name of God. Cf. 2Sam. 7.28; Ps. 102.27. See also ch. 41.4, &c. where the corresponding form is in the first person.
ago (c-7) Or 'from afar.' formed (d-17) Or 'purposed,' as ch. 46.11.
age (d-2) Or 'duration.' weaver (e-20) Or 'rolled together as the weaver.'
morning; (f-6) Some read, 'I call until the morning.'
suffering (b-15) Or 'toil.' see Note, Num. 4.3, Dan. 8.12. pardoned; (c-22) Lit. 'satisfied,' 'discharged.'
ye (d-10) Or 'A voice crying, Prepare ye in the wilderness.' see John 1.23. desert (e-19) The Arabah. see Josh. 3.16.
vanity. (a-19) Lit. 'empty' or 'desolate waste;' so also ver. 23 and elsewhere; see ch. 34.11.
foundation (b-24) In the sense of 'founding it.' lit. 'foundations.'
fall; (d-16) Or 'shall become tottering.' lit. 'stumbling, shall stumble.'
HE. (b-23) Or 'I, THE SAME,' it is really a name of God; see ch. 37.16; Deut. 32.39.
dismayed, (d-11) Or 'bewildered.' it is strictly, 'to look on one another with amazement,' or as seeking help. strengthen (e-19) Others, 'choose,' comparing it with ch. 44.14.
acacia, (h-9) Shitta, in the plural Shittim. oleaster; (i-12) Lit. 'oil-tree.' pine, (k-21) Or perhaps 'plane tree;' or 'evergreen oak.'
astonished, (b-27) Or 'examine.' see Note d, ver. 10.
heard (e-14) Or 'lift up his voice, nor cause it to be heard.'

haste, (g-8) Or 'be crushed,' in allusion to 'bruised' of the preceding verse; just as 'faint' is from the same root as 'smoking' or 'dimly burning [flax].' There is an evident correspondence between the words. justice (h-13) Or 'just judgment.'
pant (c-28) Others, 'devastate and swallow up,' as Ps. 56.1.
Seba (e-22) Mero‰, in African Ethiopia (Upper Egypt).
peoples (f-25) Leummim. see Ps. 2.1. life. (g-28) Lit. 'soul.'
ships. (d-36) Or 'whose joy is in ships.'
me, (f-16) Or 'thou hast not wearied thyself concerning me.'

mediators (a-8) Lit. 'interpreters.' those who have the office, as it were, of God's ambassadors to the people. see Job 33.23; also Gen. 42.23; 2Chron. 32.31. rebelled (b-10) See ch. 1.2, and the Note.
vanity, (g-11) As ch. 40.17,23. know; (h-30) Or 'they are witnesses for them, since they see not nor know.'
chalk; (k-15) Others, 'with an awl.' man, (l-38) Ish. man. (m-44) Adam.

terebinth (n-14) Or 'oak.' himself (o-19) Lit. 'and he maketh [it] strong for himself.' see Ps. 80.17. Others explain it in the sense of allowing the tree to grow to its full size and strength. pine, (p-29) Or 'mountain-ash.'
surnamed (d-18) The word implies a fondness of affection in the name given.
up. (b-30) Or 'let the earth open, and, together, let salvation be fruitful and righteousness spring forth.'
potsherds (c-15) Some read 'with his Maker, a potsherd among the potsherds of the earth.' work, (d-33) 'Finished work' done with a purpose, as Deut. 32.4. see chs. 5.12; 41.24; 'act,' 59.6; Ps. 64.9.
work (d-25) 'Finished work' done with a purpose, as Deut. 32.4. see chs. 5.12; 41.24; 'act,' 59.6; Ps. 64.9.
I (a-8) Or 'Surely, shall [men] say to (or, 'of') me, In Jehovah is.' righteousness (b-9) Lit. 'righteousnesses.'
Bel (c-1) Nebo (c-5) Idols of the Babylonians. carried (d-20) Images carried in procession, 'portable [gods].' on, (e-23) Or 'borne,' as ver. 3, where it is applied by way of contrast to Israel.
off; (c-30) Lit. 'avert by means of expiations.'
heavens, (d-16) i.e. astrologers. stars, (e-21) i.e. prognosticators.
be (f-26) Or 'it shall not [merely] be.' fire (g-33) Lit. 'light.'
teacheth (b-17) Or 'I, Jehovah thy God, teach.'
laboured (a-7) The Hebrew word implies exhausting labour. nought (b-16) As ch. 40.17,23. judgment (c-22) Or 'right.' work (d-28) Or 'wages.'
despiseth, (e-15) Lit. 'the despised of the soul' (i.e. of man).
bereavement (i-5) i.e. the state of having lost children.
instructed, (b-11) instructed. (b-39) Or 'learned.' as 'disciples,' ch. 8.16. 'taught,' ch. 54.13. word (c-21) Heb. Dabar. see Ps. 119.11. Or 'speak a word in season to.'
flint, (d-22) Or 'hard rock.' see Job 28.9. 'Flint' in ch. 5.28 is another word.
you; (a-11) Or 'that was in travail for you.'
nation. (b-12) Leummim, but here singular. see Gen. 25.23. establish (c-23) Or 'make to rest.'
manner; (d-40) Others 'shall die like a gnat.'
thou (f-27) 'Thou He' = 'The Same.' see ch. 37.16; Deut. 32.39; Neh. 9.6, &c. Rahab (g-31) i.e. Egypt. see ch. 30.7.
thou (f-4) 'Thou He' = 'The Same.' see ch. 37.16; Deut. 32.39; Neh. 9.6, &c.
man (h-16) Enosh, as in ver. 7. This is one of the passages in which its force, as 'mortal man,' is very clear. 'Son of man' in this verse is 'son of Adam.'
how (b-20) Or 'by whom,' but cf. Amos 7.2.
alone (c-6) Or 'held aloof.' grief, (d-16) Or 'suffering.' The word also means, 'sickness,' 'infirmity.'
griefs (d-6) Or 'suffering.' The word also means, 'sickness,' 'infirmity.' carried (e-8) Sustained. same as 'bear,' ver. 11, and 'carry,' ch. 46.4,7.

oppression (g-5) Lit. 'a shutting up,' the word having also the moral force of detention, constraint. was (h-17) According to others, 'and who, of his generation, would have thought that he would be.'
suffering. (i-13) Or 'put him to grief.' see vers. 3,4. soul (k-19) Or 'when his soul shall have made.' sin, (l-23) Asham, 'trespass-offering.' see Note b, Lev. 5.1.
many (a-25) Lit. 'the many,' i.e. those that are in relationship with him. bear (b-31) See Note e, ver. 4.
strong. (c-19) Or 'he shall have for his portion the strong as spoil.'
accomplish (d-31) Or 'make to prosper.' see Gen. 39.2.
man (f-4) Enosh, then 'son of Adam,' as in ch. 51.12.
merciful (a-12) Or 'godly,' chesed. away, (b-16) away (b-24) Or 'gathered in.' see Jer. 8.2.
[stones] (d-4) Or 'in the smooth places.' portion; (e-10) For the sense, see Jer. 3.9; Ezek. 20.32.
ways; (f-9) Or 'because of the length of thy way.' quickening (g-23) Or 'renewal.' lit. 'the life.'
aloud, (c-2) Lit. 'Cry with the throat.' See Ps. 149.6.
labours. (d-35) i.e. 'all labours due to you.'
speech, (a-39) Or 'the speaking vanity.' see Zech. 10.2.
serpents' (g-3) Perhaps 'vipers'.' But the viper's egg is not laid before it is hatched.
justice (i-3) Or 'judgment,' i.e. 'just judgment,' and so in vers. 11,14,15.
for (k-3) Or 'at,' 'along.' flourishing (a-28) Others, 'in desolate places.'
beauty (b-10) Or 'a turban,' as in ver. 10.
robe (b-31) The large outer garment worn in the East.
her, (d-26) Heb. Hephzibah. Married; (e-30) Heb. Beulah. same root as 'husband,' ch. 54.5.
remembrance, (f-27) Lit. 'think of Jehovah with loud voice.'
fury; (d-30) As 'hot displeasure,' Ps. 38.1. blood (e-33) Lit. 'juice,' alluding to the winepress.
fury; (d-17) As 'hot displeasure,' Ps. 38.1. blood (e-20) Lit. 'juice,' alluding to the winepress.
Spirit. (f-8) Or 'the Spirit of his holiness;' and so ver. 11.
shepherds (g-25) Others have the singular. him, (h-38) i.e. in Moses.
down (b-18) Or 'quake.' didst (c-3) Or 'doest.' down, (d-13) Or 'comest down.'
heard, (e-4) Or 'Even from everlasting, they have not heard.' see 1Cor. 2.9. acteth (f-19) Or 'seen except thee, O God, what he will do.'
rags; (h-17) Or 'like a menstruous garment.' Cf. ch. 30.22.
thou. (a-16) Or 'I sanctify myself in respect of thee.'
Gad, (c-16) Fortune, or planet Jupiter. Meni. (d-23) Number, or Fate, or planet Venus.
land (g-9) Or 'earth.' truth; (h-17) truth. (h-31) Heb. Amen.
but (d-36) Or 'But he shall appear to your joy, and.'
forth (e-19) Or 'Is a land brought forth.'
